about.label: 01 — about
about.title: Who is isom1ddinov?
about.text1: isom1ddinov — a frontend developer. For the past 3 years, I have been building web interfaces, from static websites to interactive web applications.
about.text2: I strive to write code that is clean, readable, and easy to maintain in the long term. In frontend development, I focus on visual details, while with Python I enjoy automation and problem solving.
about.text3: For every project, I ask one question: does this interface save people's time? I keep working until the answer is "yes".

faq.label: 09 — FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers about projects and the working process.
faq.1.question: How long does it take to create a website?
faq.1.answer: Depending on the size and complexity of the project, it usually takes from a few days to several weeks.
faq.2.question: What technologies do you use?
faq.2.answer: I mainly work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python. I can also use other technologies depending on the project requirements.
faq.3.question: Can you create responsive websites?
faq.3.answer: Yes. I create responsive websites that work properly on phones, tablets and computers.
faq.4.question: Can you deploy the finished website?
faq.4.answer: Yes. I can also help with domain, hosting or VPS configuration and deploy the website online.
faq.5.question: Can the website be modified later?
faq.5.answer: Of course. The website can be updated, new sections can be added and existing features can be modified later.
